items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'I want to speak to Joe Thomas. He's a friend of mine.'

ctx.x: So it was strictly on your own, then.

That's it. All alone. When I came to California, Lunceford was playing at Casa Manana. So the first thing I did was drop my luggage and head for the Casa Manana. Then I went backstage and I said, 'I want to speak to Joe Thomas. He's a friend of mine.' Joe got me in and got me started.
